title: Protection Bonus on Goodwill Credits for KestrelCare and Kestrel GAP Holders
content:
A goodwill credit on a late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts includes a protection bonus, a flat dollar amount added to the credit, that follows the borrower's protection products on this finance contract:

- an active KestrelCare service contract (KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts) financed in this contract together with an active Kestrel GAP Waiver on it takes the two-protection goodwill bonus, **2.00**;
- an active KestrelCare service contract financed in this contract without an active Kestrel GAP Waiver takes the one-protection goodwill bonus, **1.00**;
- any other borrower takes no bonus.

## Combinations

| Active KestrelCare service contract financed in this contract | Active Kestrel GAP Waiver on this contract | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2.00 |
| yes | no | 1.00 |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

## Points of judgement

- Both products are read for this finance contract: a service contract or GAP waiver tied to another of the borrower's finance contracts does not count.
- A product counts only while its status is active.
